prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students have in-depth knowledge of the structure, analysis, and synthesis of linear control loops in the time and frequency domain.
Students are able to model technical systems and to parameterize and validate the models using simulation studies and laboratory experiments.
Students have the competence to select suitable controller design methods for mastering these systems and to implement them in application.

syllabus_topics: Description of linear systems in the time domain (differential equations, state-space representation) and in the frequency domain (Laplace transformation, transfer function, frequency response)
Control loop structures and controller synthesis in the frequency domain
Analysis (controllability/flatness and observability) and synthesis (state feedback, state observer) in the state space
Accompanying exercise to the lecture with special consideration of mechatronics
Accompanying practical course to the lecture with special consideration of mechatronics
